Zoning Map Amendment
2052 W. 2 Ist Street
From B3-2 to B2-3

The subject property is a vacant, standard-sized 25’x125’ lot. The applicant seeks to rezone the property
to reduce the minimum lot area per unit standard and allow for the construction of a new four-story
residential building with four dwelling units. The proposed zoning height of the building will be
47-0".

The Applicant also seeks Type-I application relief pursuant to section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance for an Administrative Adjustment under section 7-13-1003-EE to reduce four
required automobile parking spaces to two for properties located at a Transit Served Location.

Proposed Zoning: B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
